per_question.final_sql: SELECT T1.Name, T1.Location FROM stadium AS T1 WHERE T1.Stadium_ID IN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM concert WHERE YEAR = '2014') INTERSECT SELECT T1.Name, T1.Location FROM stadium AS T1 WHERE T1.Stadium_ID IN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM concert WHERE YEAR = '2015')
SELECT T1.Fname, T1.Age FROM Student AS T1 INNER JOIN Has_Pet AS T2 ON T1.StuID = T2.StuID
SELECT Model FROM model_list WHERE Model IN (SELECT Model FROM cars_data WHERE Weight < (SELECT AVG(Weight) FROM cars_data))
SELECT T1.Make, T1.Year FROM car_names AS T1 INNER JOIN cars_data AS T2 ON T1.MakeId = T2.Id ORDER BY T2.Year ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT Model FROM model_list WHERE Maker IN (SELECT Id FROM car_makers WHERE Country = '1' AND FullName LIKE '%USA%') AND Model IN (SELECT Model FROM cars_data WHERE Year > 1980)
SELECT Model FROM model_list GROUP BY Model ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cars_data WHERE Cylinders > 4
SELECT FullName, Id FROM car_makers WHERE Id IN (SELECT Maker FROM model_list GROUP BY Maker HAVING COUNT(*) > 3)
SELECT T1.City FROM airports AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.AirportCode = T2.SourceAirport GROUP BY T1.City ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights WHERE DestAirport IN (SELECT AirportCode FROM airports WHERE City = 'Aberdeen' OR City = 'Abilene')
SELECT city FROM employee WHERE age < 30 GROUP BY city HAVING count(*) > 1
SELECT s.Name, COUNT(e.Employee_ID) FROM employee AS e JOIN hiring AS h ON e.Employee_ID = h.Employee_ID JOIN shop AS s ON h.Shop_ID = s.Shop_ID GROUP BY s.Name
SELECT T1.Template_ID, COUNT(*) FROM Documents AS T1 INNER JOIN Templates AS T2 ON T1.Template_ID = T2.Template_ID GROUP BY T1.Template_ID
SELECT count(*) FROM Templates
SELECT Template_ID FROM Templates WHERE Template_Type_Code = 'PP' OR Template_Type_Code = 'PPT'
SELECT T1.Template_Type_Code FROM Templates AS T1 INNER JOIN Documents AS T2 ON T1.Template_ID = T2.Template_ID WHERE T2.Document_Name = 'Data base'
SELECT T1.Other_Details FROM Paragraphs AS T1 INNER JOIN Documents AS T2 ON T1.Document_ID = T2.Document_ID WHERE T1.Paragraph_Text LIKE '%Korea%'
SELECT T1.Paragraph_Text FROM Paragraphs AS T1 INNER JOIN Documents AS T2 ON T1.Document_ID = T2.Document_ID WHERE T2.Document_Name = 'Customer reviews'
SELECT hometown ,  count(*) FROM teacher GROUP BY hometown
SELECT Name, Level_of_membership FROM visitor WHERE Level_of_membership > 4 ORDER BY Age DESC
SELECT name ,  tonnage FROM ship ORDER BY name DESC
SELECT note FROM death WHERE note LIKE '%East%'

SELECT T1.course_name FROM Courses AS T1 INNER JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id INNER JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T3 ON T2.student_enrolment_id = T3.student_enrolment_id

SELECT T1.last_name FROM Students AS T1 INNER JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.current_address_id = T2.address_id WHERE T2.state_province_county = 'North Carolina' AND T1.student_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM Student_Enrolment)
SELECT T1.first_name FROM Students AS T1 INNER JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.permanent_address_id = T2.address_id WHERE T1.current_address_id != T2.address_id
SELECT DISTINCT permanent_address_id FROM Students
SELECT Title FROM Cartoon ORDER BY Title
SELECT Language ,  COUNT(*) FROM TV_Channel GROUP BY Language
SELECT Country FROM TV_Channel WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT Channel FROM Cartoon WHERE Written_by = 'Todd Casey')
SELECT Name FROM people
SELECT Nationality FROM people GROUP BY Nationality HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

SELECT T1.contestant_number, T1.contestant_name FROM CONTESTANTS AS T1 INNER JOIN VOTES AS T2 ON T1.contestant_number = T2.contestant_number GROUP BY T1.contestant_number ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.Name, T1.Population, T1.LifeExpectancy FROM country AS T1 INNER JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.Code WHERE T2.Region = 'Asia' ORDER BY T2.SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Name FROM city WHERE CountryCode IN (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Region = 'Europe') AND Code NOT IN (SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'English')

SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Code IN (SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'English' AND Percentage = 100) INTERSECT SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Europe' AND Population = 80000
SELECT count(DISTINCT Nationality) FROM conductor
SELECT Name FROM conductor ORDER BY Year_of_Work DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT name, grade FROM Highschooler
SELECT grade FROM Highschooler GROUP BY grade HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4
SELECT name FROM Highschooler WHERE ID IN (SELECT friend_id FROM Friend WHERE student_id = (SELECT ID FROM Highschooler WHERE name = 'Kyle'))
SELECT name FROM Highschooler WHERE grade > 5 AND ID IN (SELECT student_id FROM Friend GROUP BY student_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2)
SELECT DISTINCT first_name FROM Owners WHERE first_name NOT IN (SELECT first_name FROM Dogs)
SELECT p.professional_id, p.role_code, p.first_name FROM Professionals AS p JOIN Treatments AS t ON p.professional_id = t.professional_id GROUP BY p.professional_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
Select first_name ,  last_name ,  email_address FROM Owners WHERE city LIKE '%North%' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Dogs WHERE CAST(age AS REAL) < (SELECT AVG(CAST(age AS REAL)) FROM Dogs)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Professionals WHERE professional_id NOT IN (SELECT professional_id FROM Treatments)
SELECT name, age, weight FROM Dogs WHERE abandoned_yn = '1'
SELECT charge_type ,  charge_amount FROM Charges
SELECT MAX(charge_amount) FROM Charges
SELECT Name FROM singer ORDER BY Net_Worth_Millions ASC
